meeting_point: Maximo Park Boat Ramp, St. Petersburg, FL 33711
description:
#Explore St. Pete’s Waters with a Private Snorkeling Charter!

##Discover the Hidden Gems of Florida’s Gulf Coast

Set out on a 4-hour private snorkeling adventure from St. Petersburg, Florida, aboard our 32’ luxury boat, Zen Dog. Dive into crystal-clear waters, explore historic underwater ruins, encounter vibrant marine life, and enjoy the stunning beauty of Egmont Key, Shell Key, and other hidden gems. Bring up to 11 guests for an unforgettable day filled with snorkeling, sun, and adventure. We’ll provide the gear, ice, water, and sunscreen—you bring your curiosity and a sense of wonder!

##Your High-End Snorkeling Boat: Zen Dog

Step aboard Zen Dog, a premium 32’ WorldCat center console catamaran designed for comfort and speed. Featuring twin 300-horsepower engines, Zen Dog ensures a smooth ride to the best snorkeling spots, with plenty of room for up to 12 guests. With professional-grade snorkeling equipment provided, you can focus on exploring Florida’s underwater treasures in style.

##Make Your Trip Truly Special

Looking for something unique? Our custom charters let you go beyond snorkeling! Add personalized experiences like:

Offshore Spearfishing: Test your skills with a thrilling spearfishing excursion.
Sandbar Parties: Relax and soak up the sun at St. Pete’s favorite sandbars.
Discover Scuba Diving: Dive deeper with an introductory scuba session led by professionals.
Romantic Sunset Cruises: Enjoy a private sunset experience tailored for you.

Whatever your vision, we’ll help bring it to life!

##What to Bring
We’ve got the essentials covered, but here’s what we recommend for your group:

Towels
BYOB and Snacks
A Ready-to-Explore Attitude

Meeting us is easy—just arrive at Maximo Boat Park in St. Pete, and we’ll handle the rest.

Also, we may have a member of our social media intern team come aboard and shoot content. 

##Book Your Adventure Today
Ready to experience the beauty of St. Pete’s waters like never before? Book today to reserve your spot. Let’s make some unforgettable memories together!
